scope: Mobile/Steam Campaign, Normal difficulty, no purchased star upgrades. Exact historical build number is not established by these community references.
policy: Reuse established mechanics, economy and progression together; map owned artwork to roles. Unverified details remain null or pending, never invented as original-game values.

runtime_mapping.local_version: 0.3.0 validated in isolated browser and uploaded as independent development H5 version 287989; physical host unverified
runtime_mapping.baseline: KR1 mobile/Steam Campaign, Normal difficulty, with no purchased star upgrades
runtime_mapping.skin_rule: The two visuals in each family share the same baseline costs, damage, interval, range and level data. Base skins grant no slow, chain, burn or stun.
runtime_mapping.barracks: Each barracks creates three damageable soldiers with ground blocking, melee combat, rally movement, out-of-combat recovery, death and timed replacement.
runtime_mapping.abilities: Reinforcements and Rain of Fire are implemented with stage/wave unlocks and cooldowns.
runtime_mapping.progression: Schema v2 stores unlocks, wins and best 1-3 star result. Stars use remaining-life thresholds 1/6/18; unknown or invalid saves are preserved and writes are disabled for that session.
adaptations_remaining: Map coordinates, route geometry and the 1024x576 world scale are local layouts rather than verified original stage coordinates.
Spawn gaps and projectile speeds are local presentation values because the cited community references do not establish them.
Rain of Fire applies three simultaneous impacts around the target with a local radius; original impact timing and radius have not been verified.
There is no early-wave countdown or early-call gold reward. Waves are started manually between intermissions, so exact original encounter balance is not claimed.
Advanced tower branches and purchasing star talents are not implemented.

openfield_runtime_mapping.local_version: 0.4.0 current open-field implementation in dist/openfield.js; local development state
openfield_runtime_mapping.baseline: The recorded KR1 mobile/Steam Campaign Normal values remain the numerical source. Open-field placement, free movement between waves and the encounter itself are local adaptations rather than an original KR1 stage.
openfield_runtime_mapping.implementation_source: dist/openfield.js OF_TYPES, OF_ADAPTATIONS, OF_ENEMIES and OF_WAVES

frontline.guard: Barracks grade 1 aggregated into one field unit: cost 70; HP 3×50=150; damage 3×(1-3)=3-9; interval 1 s; armor 0.
frontline.sentinel: Barracks grade 2 aggregated into one field unit: cumulative cost 70+110=180; HP 3×100=300; damage 3×(3-4)=9-12; interval 1.37 s; armor 0.15.
frontline.berserker: Barracks grade 3 aggregated into one field unit: cumulative cost 70+110+160=340; HP 3×150=450; damage 3×(6-10)=18-30; interval 1.37 s; armor 0.3.
frontline.aggregation_rule: One recruited frontline body represents the output of three KR1 barracks soldiers. Recruitment prices are the matching barracks purchase or cumulative upgrade costs, not independently authored prices.

ranged.archer: Archer grade 1: cost 70, damage 4-6, interval 0.8 s, range 140, physical.
ranged.ranger: Archer grade 2: cumulative cost 70+110=180, damage 7-11, interval 0.6 s, range 160, physical.
ranged.sniper: Archer grade 3: cumulative cost 70+110+160=340, damage 10-16, interval 0.5 s, range 180, physical.
ranged.mage: Mage grade 1: cost 100, damage 9-17, interval 1.5 s, range 140, magic.
ranged.flame: Mage grade 2: cumulative cost 100+160=260, damage 23-43, interval 1.5 s, range 160, magic; the flame visual adds no burn.
ranged.frost: Elora level-one Frost Bolt supplies 15-41 magic damage, 1.8 s interval and 50% slow for 2 s. Range 180 and recruitment cost 100+160+240=500 are local derivations from mage grade 3; Elora has no gold purchase price.
ranged.storm: Tesla x104 supplies 26 or 39 electric damage per target, 2.2 s interval, three targets and jump distance 95. Range 180 and recruitment cost 125+220+320=665 are local derivations from artillery grade 3; no Supercharged Bolt or Overcharge purchase is included.

support.healer: Reuses Shaman HP 100 and healing 50 every 8 s; cost 100 is derived from mage grade 1.
support.summoner: Reuses Reinforcements count 2, HP 30, damage 1-2, duration 20 s and cooldown 10 s; cost 70 is derived from militia barracks grade 1. A local cap of four simultaneous summons prevents unlimited accumulation.

recruitment_mapping.towers: Arrow, mage, cannon and barracks towers use the recorded three-grade KR1 costs and combat values. Only towers can buy grade upgrades; recruited units have no upgrade action.

combat_adaptations.deterministic_damage: Ordinary non-splash attacks resolve each recorded damage range at its arithmetic midpoint instead of rolling within the range. Damage is applied immediately when an attack begins.
combat_adaptations.visual_projectiles: Ranged attacks also create a 0.22 s visual projectile, but collision does not delay or reapply damage; the projectile is presentation for the already-resolved hit.
combat_adaptations.automation: Combat has no unit micro-control: deployed units automatically acquire targets, move within their leash, attack, heal or summon. Placement and troop relocation are limited to deployment and intermission phases.
combat_adaptations.tower_upgrades_only: Only tower-category entities can upgrade to levels 2 and 3. Frontline, ranged and support recruits remain fixed profiles.
combat_adaptations.local_world_rules: The 1024×576 open field, three entrances, free placement, obstacle collision, routefinding, unit durability, movement speed, leash behavior and tower structure HP are local implementation rules.
combat_adaptations.recovery: After 2 seconds without attacking or taking damage, recorded militia regeneration 5/7/10 HP per second applies by grade. Single frontline bodies aggregate three soldiers (15/21/30); ranged/support recruits derive 5 from grade-one militia; temporary reinforcements use recorded 3. Recovery continues between waves.

encounter_adaptation.composition: Locally authored multi-entrance sequence using Goblin, Orc, Wulf, Shaman and Ogre-style progression; spawn order and the 0.58 s global spawn spacing are local rather than sourced KR1 wave data.
encounter_adaptation.boss: The final Ancient Tree Beast presentation reuses the Ogre numerical baseline: HP 800, armor 0, magic resistance 0, speed 26.9, reward 50, breach cost 3, damage 40-60 and interval 1.8 s. The boss flag and artwork do not create a separate sourced KR1 boss profile.
encounter_adaptation.claim_limit: The nine-wave encounter is an authored local scenario and must not be described as a reproduction of a KR1 campaign wave table.
encounter_adaptation.low_input_revision: Initial 78-enemy draft concentrated pressure in waves 6–9. Reduce these authored groups from 43 to 29; remove the extra wave-8 Ogre and final Ogre escort. Keep all source tower/troop/enemy profiles and early five waves unchanged. This local slice targets planning-only play without Rain of Fire.

evidence_limits: Community documentation, not an official exported balance database. Fandom direct-page access was blocked; available search-index extracts were read.
Fandom uses displayed damage bounds; Wikily distinguishes actual projectile ceil rounding. Do not mix these two columns.
Fandom major-axis range is a diameter; Wikily lists radius. Convert coordinate scale only after map dimensions are established.
The Outskirts is the mobile/Steam name; older Flash references call it The Farmlands.
Exclude Frontiers, Origins, Battles and Genesis/Classic Rush variants from this baseline.
Wave counts and composition do not supply spawn intervals, route points or timing. These require further verification before implementing a matching encounter.

artillery.damage_model: Explosion damage falls with distance from impact; bounds are not a random single-target roll.

economy_and_growth.own_draft_flat_wave_bonus_20: withdrawn; not supported as the reference game's standard economy

implementation_prerequisites: Verify or deliberately retain the local map coordinates, route travel time, firing coverage and 1024x576 world scale before claiming original-stage equivalence.
Verify original spawn intervals and projectile speeds if closer encounter timing is required; current values are local presentation adaptations.
Verify Rain of Fire impact sequencing and radius; the current three simultaneous local-radius impacts are an adaptation.
Implement an early-wave countdown and verified early-call reward before claiming the original inter-wave economy; the current game waits for a manual wave call.
Implement advanced tower branches and star-talent purchasing before describing the broader KR1 progression system as complete.
